Moses’ mother
One of her maidens

Among the flags
Inside the palace

Clothing
A crying baby

She closed the ark
She called her father

Her maid or servant
Her daughter

She knew his parents
She saw that he was crying

The child’s mother
Pharaoh’s daughter
easy.explanation: The child’s sister offered to call a Hebrew nurse.

easy.question: Whom did the girl call after Pharaoh’s daughter told her to go?
answers: Pharaoh’s daughter
The child’s mother
An Egyptian woman
easy.explanation: The girl went and called the child’s mother.

answers: Aaron, because she rescued him
Hebrew, because he was Hebrew
Moses, because she drew him out of the water
easy.explanation: She called him Moses because she had drawn him out of the water.

medium.question: What happened after Pharaoh’s daughter agreed to the girl’s suggestion?
answers: The girl called the child’s mother
The child was returned to the river
Pharaoh’s daughter left the area
medium.explanation: After Pharaoh’s daughter said, “Go,” the girl went and called the child’s mother.

medium.question: What did Pharaoh’s daughter mean by “Take this child away”?
answers: Hide the child
Take the child and care for him
Give the child a name
medium.explanation: She told the woman to take the child and nurse him for her.

medium.question: Why did the woman later bring the child to Pharaoh’s daughter?

Pharaoh’s daughter wanted to return him to the river
Pharaoh’s daughter accepted him as her son

Two Hebrew men

He left it where it was

The Egyptian
One of the Hebrews

The Hebrew ran away from him

They were quarreling

To find a place to bury the Hebrew

Canaan

They asked him to become a shepherd
Pharaoh commanded him to help

Reuel
One of the shepherds

easy.question: What did Reuel’s daughters do after Moses helped them?
answers: They immediately returned to Egypt
They watered the flock
They went back to their father
easy.explanation: They returned to their father and told him what had happened.

easy.question: What name did Moses give his son?

Reuel
Zipporah
easy.explanation: Moses called his son Gershom.

medium.question: Why did Reuel’s daughters arrive home early that day?
answers: Moses helped them water the flock quickly
Their father sent them home
They could not find the flock
medium.explanation: Moses rescued them from the shepherds and watered the flock, so they finished their work early.

Call Moses and invite him to eat
Ask the shepherds to thank him
medium.explanation: Reuel asked where Moses was and told his daughters to call him so he could eat bread.

Moses hurried away
Moses became angry with him
medium.explanation: The verse says that Moses was content to dwell with the man.

Moses was born near a well
Moses wanted to be a shepherd

Moses rescued the daughters, they told their father, and he invited Moses into his household
Reuel invited Moses, then the daughters met him, and finally he watered the flock
challenge.explanation: First Moses helped the daughters at the well; they told Reuel, who then asked them to call Moses.

answers: He viewed Moses as an enemy to drive away
He feared that Moses would take the flock
He appreciated Moses’ help and wanted to welcome him
challenge.explanation: Reuel asked why the daughters had left Moses and told them to call him to eat, showing that he welcomed and appreciated him.

paragraphs.title: The Cry of the Israelites Is Heard

easy.question: Who died at the beginning of the passage?
answers: The king of Egypt
Moses
Another Pharaoh
easy.explanation: The verse says, “The king of Egypt died.”

easy.question: What did the Israelites do because of their bondage?
answers: They left Egypt
They sighed and cried out
They built a palace
easy.explanation: The Israelites sighed because of their bondage and cried out to God.

easy.question: To whom did the cry of the Israelites rise?
answers: The king of Egypt
Moses
God
easy.explanation: The verse says that their cry came up unto God.

medium.question: What happened after the Israelites sighed because of their bondage?
answers: They quietly returned to work
They cried out, and their cry came up to God
They immediately left Egypt
medium.explanation: They first sighed, then cried out, and their cry rose to God.

medium.question: Why is God’s covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob mentioned?
answers: They were kings of Egypt
They directed the labor in Egypt
The covenant concerned the Israelites and their ancestors
medium.explanation: God remembered the covenant he had made with the ancestors of the nation: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

medium.question: What does the phrase “God heard their groaning” show?
answers: He heard their sighs and cries of suffering
He heard songs of joy
He heard orders about their work
medium.explanation: Their groaning was an expression of pain and suffering caused by their bondage.

challenge.question: What can we infer from the movement from sighing to crying out?
answers: Their work became easier
They stopped complaining
Their distress led them to cry loudly for help
challenge.explanation: The movement from sighing to crying out emphasizes the intensity of their distress and their appeal for help.

challenge.question: Why is the phrase “because of their bondage” repeated?
answers: To emphasize the source of their suffering and cries
To describe only the type of work they did
To show that they enjoyed their work
challenge.explanation: The repetition makes clear that their sighing and cries were caused by their harsh bondage.

challenge.question: What is implied by the ending, “God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them”?
answers: God learned about Egypt for the first time
God fully recognized their distress and responded to it
God forgot the covenant
challenge.explanation: The sequence shows that God heard their cries, saw their condition, and took notice of their suffering.
